from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyExpense(BaseModel):
    """One company's expense data for the specified period."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name from the filing")
    expense_label: str | None = Field(description="The line-item label as written in the filing (e.g. 'Advertising, selling, general and administrative', 'Total Operating Expenses')")
    expense_amount: float | None = Field(description="The expense amount as reported")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="Scale of the reported amount: 'thousands', 'millions', 'dollars'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The period the expenses cover (e.g. 'three months ended March 31, 2024')")
    is_operating_or_admin: bool | None = Field(description="Whether this expense line represents operating and/or administrative expenses as per the task query")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim text snippet containing the expense figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_expenses: list[CompanyExpense]
